narrativeProgression.description: Blood flow from the right ventricle through the pulmonary semilunar valve is explained.
Blood entering the pulmonary arteries and traveling to the lungs is described.
Oxygenated blood returning through the pulmonary veins to the left atrium is explained.

Blood exiting the left ventricle through the aortic semilunar valve into the aorta is explained.
